components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Filled action on a light surface.
components.css: .ds-button-dark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:35px; min-height:60px; padding:20px 24px; background:var(--ink,#142c28); color:var(--cream,#f3f6ef); font:600 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background .25s,transform .25s; } .ds-button-dark:hover { background:#28554b; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-dark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange,#f46e43); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Light Button
components.description: Filled email action on the dark contact surface.
components.css: .ds-button-light { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:35px; min-height:60px; padding:20px 24px; background:var(--cream,#f3f6ef); color:var(--ink,#142c28); font:600 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background .25s,transform .25s; } .ds-button-light:hover { background:#e5e9db; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-light:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange,#f46e43); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Plain desktop navigation with a signal-color hover and visible focus.

components.name: Service Row
components.description: Visible situation and service explanation, divided by fine rules.
components.html:
People arrive, but they are not sure what you do or what to do next.

Websites & development

Make your offer easier to understand with a website or landing page.
components.css: .ds-service { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(240px,.62fr) 1fr; gap:9vw; padding:42px 0 46px; border-top:1px solid var(--line,#cdd2c7); color:var(--ink,#142c28); } .ds-service-situation { max-width:320px; margin:2px 0 0; color:var(--muted,#465c51); font:400 17px/1.55 'DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-service-detail h3 { margin:0 0 16px; font:700 36px/1.1 'Bricolage',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-service-detail p { max-width:630px; margin:0; font:400 17px/1.62 'DM Sans',sans-serif; }

components.name: Starting Point
components.description: A bordered text block for one of two business starting situations.
components.html:
Starting from scratch?

Begin with a clear explanation of what you offer and an easy way for people to contact you.
components.css: .ds-path { padding:43px 6vw 51px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#142c28); border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink,#142c28); color:var(--ink,#142c28); } .ds-path h3 { margin:0 0 19px; font:700 34px/1.1 'Bricolage',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-path p { max-width:520px; margin:0; color:var(--muted,#465c51); font:400 17px/1.65 'DM Sans',sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: An editorial layout pairs the direct hero offer with a diagram of the ways a small business can be found. Below it, visible explanations lead from familiar business situations to relevant services, then to two possible starting points and an email conversation. Strong display type, broad color fields, and fine dividers keep the long page legible. This is a starting identity pending owner review.
dos: Do keep service explanations readable for New Zealand small business owners.
Do use signal color deliberately and keep text contrast high.
Do keep service content visible without requiring interaction.
donts: Don't add unverified results, clients, certifications, or testimonials.
Don't replace the open editorial sections with generic cards or dashboards.
